title: A5 - Proposal Reference Architecture / Phase-1 Baseline
decision_statement: A5 freezes the dual-feed extended-Hall architecture as the proposal reference configuration. Atmospheric propellant is the primary discharge feed. Xe is reserved for ignition, the isolated LaB6 cathode and bounded contingency usage; continuous Xe augmentation of the atmospheric discharge is not an acceptable nominal operating mode. RF pre-ionization is retained as an interface-ready Phase-1 contingency, with ECR as the alternate. H-1 determines whether the flight propulsion branch is Hall-only, RF+Hall or ECR+Hall using same-condition atmospheric sustainment and common-bus performance tests. Until H-1 is passed, the architecture is a proposal baseline, not a validated flight design.
what_this_is_not: not a claim that Hall-only atmospheric operation has been validated
not an admission of any Hall transport closure (credible set remains empty; A4 project conclusion unchanged)
not a performance prediction: all thrust, power, mass and life numbers below are allocations or requirements
effect_on_parallel_work: Hall, RF+Hall and ECR+Hall are no longer carried as three equal proposal architectures. All lanes work inside this frozen architecture; the single open branch is the propulsion-source branch (Hall-only / RF+Hall / ECR+Hall / no viable case), resolved by H-1 Phase 1. Facility, ExB, O/O2 and Hall-map work do not gate A5.

xe_branch: Xe metering (splits to ignition/transition feed and cathode feed)

reserved_interface.name: RF pre-ionization module interface
reserved_interface.location: between feed/plenum and Hall ionization region
reserved_interface.requirement: a defined electrical, mechanical, gas and control ICD is produced now so that fitting RF after H-1 does not require redesigning the thruster

architecture.alternate: ECR pre-ionization: alternate test module only, not baseline installed flight hardware; used only if RF fails the common-boundary comparison

operating_modes.nominal_mode: atmospheric Hall discharge with Xe-fed cathode
rules: continuous Xe support of the main discharge is not a nominal mode; if the atmospheric discharge needs it to stay lit, the atmospheric Hall concept has failed its Phase-1 objective
every mode that consumes Xe carries an explicit maximum duration and draws on the single fixed Xe allocation
mixed/transition operation never silently becomes a long-duration operating mode

xe_mass_allocation.ledger: m_Xe_total = m_cathode + m_startup + m_transition + m_fallback + m_reserve; every operating mode consumes against this one fixed tank allocation
xe_mass_allocation.cathode_flow_upper_status: test point only until the mass ledger demonstrates it is affordable
xe_mass_allocation.rejection_illustration: 0.74 mg/s over 15,000 h consumes the whole 40 kg; illustrates rejection only, never an allowable allocation
xe_mass_allocation.m_Xe_total_value: PENDING_OWNER: set from the system mass ledger; the startup, transition, fallback and reserve terms are to be allocated

allocations_and_requirements.status: allocation leaving margin to the 1.5 kW requirement; P_bus per bus_power_boundary_v1
allocation leaving margin to the 40 kg requirement

allocation_rule: ECHT and other analogue data are never presented as predictions of Vyovrinda hardware; these values never enter a predicted-performance table

phase1_branch_decision.test_matrix: H-1 sweeps mdot_atm x x_O2 x V_d jointly, with point density concentrated near the anticipated low-flow knee around the delivered-flow region (<= ~3.2 mg/s under H_RAM) and across the delivered O2 mass fraction 0.42-0.60
phase1_branch_decision.common_condition: same feed state and same accelerator condition for all three at a point
phase1_branch_decision.discriminator_note: source power is never assessed separately; it enters through P_bus

cases.A_extended_hall: atmospheric discharge sustains across the required low-flow/composition envelope, meets the pre-registered stability/utilization criteria, and needs no continuous Xe support
cases.B_rf_hall: Hall-only fails one or more required atmospheric points, and RF restores operation with a net system-level benefit after RF source, matching and PPU power and mass are counted
cases.C_ecr_hall: Hall-only fails, RF fails its common-boundary criterion, and ECR passes it
cases.NO_VIABLE_CASE: none meets the common bus-power, thrust, stability, mass and life constraints; no case is forced to win

phase1_branch_decision.preregistration: the acceptance criteria for these cases are pre-registered through the existing LOCK-1/LOCK-2 path before any score-bearing H-1 data; A5 fixes the structure, not the numeric thresholds

architecture_closing_risks.risk: atmospheric sustainment at low mass flow and high O2 fraction
architecture_closing_risks.evidence: all 9 air cases UNDETERMINED; delivered O2 fraction 0.42-0.60 vs 0.47 max tested; published air/N2-O2 points at 2.75-7 mg/s vs <= ~3.2 mg/s delivered
architecture_closing_risks.response: H-1 Phase 1; RF/ECR are the contingency response to this risk

architecture_closing_risks.evidence: PPS1350 on N2/O2 + 10 % Xe: 7,000-9,500 h (0.47-0.63 of requirement); anode-oxidation flame-out ~314 h (Andreussi 2022, second-hand review)
architecture_closing_risks.response: oxidation-resistant anode/channel materials and a life test

architecture_closing_risks.risk: Xe-fed cathode consumption and oxygen isolation
architecture_closing_risks.response: measured cathode flow at <= 0.10 mg/s design target; shielding/isolation from the atmospheric plume

architecture_closing_risks.risk: total bus-power and mass closure with all auxiliaries
architecture_closing_risks.response: bus_power_boundary_v1 ledger closure under the allocations above

evidence_basis: docs/architecture_comparison/ (feed-state closure, RF/ECR overlays, aux bus, veto layer)
docs/milestones/bundle1/ (NO_BASELINE_YET under B1-DR-1; A5 is a proposal reference, not a Bundle-1 CONDITIONAL_BASELINE verdict)
